title: Three Dressed-Up Children, 1957 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white photograph from February 1957 capturing three young children smartly dressed for a formal occasion or portrait. Two young boys wear suits with bow ties while a baby girl sits between them in a frilly lace dress. To their right on the floral-patterned sofa sits a souvenir pillow that reads 'U.S. ARMY FORT HOOD, TEXAS'. A calendar with 'PARIS' text hangs on the wall behind them. The photo edge bears the timestamp 'FEB • 57'.
